# Operating Model

1. Establish verified current state.
2. Accept the executive decision and target state.
3. Assign one authority per durable responsibility.
4. Resolve or explicitly block decisions and Unknowns.
5. Register targets and evidence.
6. Decompose into workstreams and Task Cards.
7. Encode task dependencies once in the dependency graph.
8. Group tasks into evidence-gated waves.
9. Set authorization ceilings and rollback before execution.
10. Import into the Controller and execute against exact state.
11. Accept the Controller Handoff Receipt through explicit program governance.
12. Declare a terminal verdict only when Definition of Done is satisfied.
